data.long_meaning: The name Nurjenna is derived from the Arabic words 'nur' meaning 'light' and 'janna' meaning 'garden' or 'heaven'. It is a beautiful name that conveys the idea of a radiant and heavenly woman, illuminated by the light of faith and wisdom. The name Nurjenna carries the meaning “Light of the beautiful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nurjenna usually hope their child will grow to embody light of the beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
